# Project-Specific Copilot Instructions

This is a Next.js notification application with TypeScript and Material UI.

## Project Structure

- **notification_app_be** - Backend notification service
- **notification_app_fe** - Frontend notification UI  
- **logging/middleware** - Centralized logging utilities
- **notification_system_design.md** - Architecture documentation

## Development Guidelines

### TypeScript
- Maintain strict mode enabled
- Use proper type annotations
- Create interfaces for complex data structures

### Material UI (MUI)
- Use MUI components for all UI elements
- Follow MUI theming conventions
- Customize theme in app configuration

### Logging
- Use the logging middleware for all application logging
- Include request/response logging
- Track performance metrics

### Backend
- Implement RESTful API endpoints
- Use proper HTTP status codes
- Validate all incoming data

### Frontend
- Create reusable components
- Use React hooks for state management
- Implement error boundaries
